description:
Bug report from a user of mistune: mistune.html("*foo***bar*") returns "

foo**bar*

\n", but CommonMark renders this input as "

foo*bar

". Find the problem and fix it. Change src/mistune/ only.
environment: Python >= 3.13 stdlib; base tree = mistune 2d26bc8^ (src, tests, docs, LICENSE, README, pyproject, .gitignore) plus the task-owned helper bench_fixtures/md.py; no repository history
visible_checks: PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest tests.test_commonmark tests.test_syntax (from the workspace root)
provenance: real fix: lepture/mistune commit 2d26bc8 (fix(inline): use original run length in emphasis multiple-of-3 rule, 2026-06-26); reference/good.patch is that commit's src/ diff; symptom-only description (one input and the CommonMark output); hidden cases authored for agent-benchmark (2026-10-18): other partially consumed runs (closer and opener side, strong, mixed content) plus guards, every expected value equal to both the fixed tree and commonmark.py 0.9.1; the rule (CommonMark rules 9 and 10) is in the CommonMark spec, whose examples ship in the base as tests/fixtures/commonmark.json; other reference patches built by build_task.py. Public repository: contamination possible
